# O2om (قُوم) — Stand-Up Break Timer & Posture Health Reminder for Windows

> O2om (derived from Arabic "قُوم", meaning "Stand up!") is an open-source, lightweight desktop health utility for Windows built with AutoHotkey v2. It monitors physical inactivity, auto-pauses when users step away from their desk, and prompts periodic posture stretch breaks with full Arabic (RTL) and English support.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Project Name: O2om (قُوم)
- Version: v2.5.3
- Target Platform: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Language & Runtime: AutoHotkey v2.0+
- Architecture: Non-blocking millisecond delta state engine (O2omEngine)
- Localization: Native Arabic (Right-to-Left layout via WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL +E0x400000) & English
- Visual Theme: Catppuccin Mocha Dark Palette
- Display Support: Responsive 16:9 stretch graphic scaling from 768p to 4K
- License: Open Source

## Core Features
1. Auto-Starting Work Timer: Session countdown starts automatically on launch or break completion.
2. Pause & Resume Controls: Manual session pausing for unscheduled desk breaks.
3. Fullscreen Desk Exercise Guidance: Guided 16:9 posture stretch illustrations (Neck Retraction, Shoulder Rolls, Seated Torso Twist, Standing Hamstring Stretch, Eye Relaxation 20-20-20).
4. Physical Idle Detection: Auto-pauses work timer when physical input (mouse/keyboard) is inactive beyond configurable threshold via A_TimeIdlePhysical.
5. Zero-Flicker GUI Rendering: Utilizes WS_CLIPCHILDREN (+0x02000000) to eliminate GDI text redraw flicker during 1-second ticks.
6. Post-Break Workflow: Automatically closes fullscreen exercise overlay on break completion (00:00) and displays a manual "Start Work" button on the main dashboard.

## Installation & Links

- Repository: https://github.com/BelalWaheed/o2om
